equipment_type: Electronic mixing valve with thermal disinfection
applies_to: Caleffi 6003 Series LEGIOMIXevo electronic mixing valves for central domestic hot water systems, firmware 2.0.0 or higher.
summary: LEGIOMIXevo is an electronic 3-way mixing valve controller for domestic hot water that holds the mixed outlet temperature and runs scheduled thermal disinfection (anti-legionella) cycles. Over BACnet IP it exposes the mixing, recirculation and storage temperatures, the mixing setpoint, the running function and alarm codes, relay states, feature flags and identification strings.
notes: From sections 5.2-5.5 of the LEGIOMIXevo PICS; state codes for AV 10 and AV 11 come from Annex A and Annex B.
Only AV 17 Mixing Temperature Set lists Present Value as writable; everything else is read-only.
Relay BVs: 1 = relay closed, 0 = not closed (written here as Open/Closed). Temperature units follow the Units property (°C, °F).
The Network Port object (no instance printed) is left out.
Revision 2 (18/03/2026) removed BACnet MS/TP; the page header still prints Rev. 01.

source.title: LEGIOMIXevo Electronic Mixing Valve with thermal disinfection - BACnet Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement (PICS)

integration.summary: Read the mixed water, recirculation and storage temperatures, the running function (AV 10) and alarm code (AV 11). The BMS can change the mixing setpoint (AV 17). Disinfection and other programs run from the valve controller itself.

minimum_points.name: Relay 5 - ALARM
minimum_points.why: Alarm relay closed on alarm or power loss

setup: BACnet IP only (Annex J); the data link is set from the touch display.
gotchas: Alarm relay BV 24 is also closed when the unit is not powered.
A disinfection or shock cycle can raise the outlet temperature well above the mixing setpoint.
